description: This file defines an XML schema for a simple method used to perform units of measure (UoM) conversions specific to products within the OFBiz framework. It contains a method convertUomProduct which calculates conversion factors based on product attributes, and is used for handling product-related UoM conversions.

methods.name: convertUomProduct
methods.description: Performs a UoM conversion for a product based on its attributes and specified UoMs, calculating a conversion factor and applying it to a given value.
